ROUTE_IDENTITY.basis: current OR route declarations and held OJD source
ROUTE_IDENTITY.finding: The no-court route selects Option 3 and the court-case dismissal route selects Option 2; the no-court Case No. remains blank.

SOURCE_IDENTITY.basis: exact current source receipt and held bytes
SOURCE_IDENTITY.finding: Both exact OR official sources match their current receipt SHA-256 and byte length.

COMPONENT_SET.basis: current legal-clear delivery declaration and frozen eight-PDF manifest
COMPONENT_SET.finding: The court packet consists of the motion/declaration and filing instructions; the OSP request is separately addressed as an agency handoff, with all four court and four agency PDFs frozen.

KNOWN_PREFILLS.basis: current write map plus saved-byte preflight
KNOWN_PREFILLS.finding: Supported neutral identity, county/case and OSP destination facts are present; participant-owned fields remain handback.

REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.finding: The current ledger names the route evidence, recipient address, OSP contact fields, offense rows and required eligibility handbacks.

ROUTE_OPTIONS.basis: current route selections and saved text
ROUTE_OPTIONS.finding: Option 3, Option 2 and OSP NO are the only route selections; off-route and conviction controls are refused or left unmarked by policy.

REPEATING_ROWS.finding: The five physical citation/arrest offense rows are distinct; border rules are not facts and overflow is a participant continuation-page handback.

PROTECTED_FIELDS.basis: current field map and actual write/refusal reports
PROTECTED_FIELDS.finding: Signatures, dates, sworn declaration choices, fingerprint completion and fee payment remain protected or participant-owned; no proposed order is fabricated.

ARTIFACTS.basis: current saved-byte preflight and current PDF audit
ARTIFACTS.finding: All eight current PDFs match the frozen manifest by SHA-256, byte length and parsed page count; the original Actions custody verifies all 36 original pages.

PAGE_ORDER.basis: current rendered-artifacts and manifest page bindings
PAGE_ORDER.finding: Each court PDF is seven pages and each separate OSP PDF is two pages; all eight PDFs are covered.

CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.basis: Direct review of 18 unique custody-verified original PNG byte hashes and exact SHA/byte-length reuse for all 36 positions.
CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.finding: All 36 custody-verified original PNG positions are covered. Every unique PNG byte hash was directly viewed; duplicate positions were accepted only by exact hash and byte-length reuse. No clipping, overlap, missing ink, unintended blank page or unauthorized protected-field ink was observed.

FILING_DESTINATION.basis: current separate-agency declaration and filing guidance
FILING_DESTINATION.finding: The court filing packet and separate OSP handoff are explicitly distinguished, with sequence delegated to current county/jurisdiction instructions.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.basis: current OSP source text and participant guidance
FEE_AND_WAIVER.finding: The OSP $33 line is described as conviction-only; these nonconviction routes leave it unmarked and no provider charge is invented.

SERVICE.finding: The prosecuting-office mailing address is required, with a conditional second line; service date and signature remain blank until performed.

SELF_HELP_STOP.basis: current route handbacks and stop guidance
SELF_HELP_STOP.finding: Declination/disposition evidence and dates plus DUII, traffic, pending/contempt, multiple-county, federal/out-of-state, firearm and immigration stops are explicit.
